description: A signed release manifest that binds a version to immutable artifacts and a package index. A release is data; installing or deploying it is a separate operator action.

release.package_index_sha256: 64 lowercase hex characters over the canonical package index bytes.
release.signature_b64: Ed25519 signature over the release projection; it proves provenance and grants nothing.

distribution.channel: The existing signed 4221 read-only file share carries the release manifest and artifacts bundle; no new port is introduced.
distribution.install: A peer verifies the release and package signatures, checks every digest and writes only into _staging/; an explicit operator action performs installation.
distribution.rollback: The previous release manifest remains available; rollback is an explicit install of that manifest, never a silent overwrite.

rules: A release cannot grant a capability or execute itself.
A release is immutable once signed; a changed artifact requires a new release_id.
Every artifact path is relative and stays inside the release root.
A package index digest that disagrees with the referenced index is refused.
A release channel never bypasses the package install plan or the operator action.
